description: Find South Korean elementary, middle and high schools by name (Korean, partial names work: '상계고', '서울 대치초'). Returns eduCode and schoolCode needed by the other tools, plus school type, province and address.

name.description: School name in Korean, e.g. '상계고등학교', '효자고', '의정부 효자고'

region.description: Province/metropolitan city to narrow results, e.g. '서울특별시', '경기도'

name: search_schools
title: Search Korean schools
